  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import eigh_tridiagonal


def calibrate_affine_banks(raw_observations: np.ndarray, observation_banks: np.ndarray, references: np.ndarray, sweep_readouts: np.ndarray, sweep_banks: np.ndarray, *, spike_sigma: float = 5.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Invert per-bank raw = gain * reference + offset from in-batch sweeps.

    Assumes isolated readout spikes and at least two distinct clean reference
    levels per used bank. Estimate by median slopes, screen at five scaled MADs
    by default, and refit on inliers. No gain ridge or historical prior is used.
    """
    y = np.asarray(raw_observations, dtype=float).copy()
    row_bank, sweep_bank = np.asarray(observation_banks), np.asarray(sweep_banks)
    ref, raw = np.asarray(references, dtype=float), np.asarray(sweep_readouts, dtype=float)
    eps = np.finfo(float).eps
    for bank in np.unique(row_bank):
        x, r = ref[sweep_bank == bank], raw[sweep_bank == bank]
        if x.size < 2:
            raise ValueError('A used bank lacks an identifiable sweep.')
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        dx = x[j] - x[i]
        valid = np.abs(dx) > 32 * eps * np.ptp(x)
        if not valid.any():
            raise ValueError('A used bank has no distinct reference levels.')
        gain = np.median((r[j[valid]] - r[i[valid]]) / dx[valid])
        offset = np.median(r - gain * x)
        predicted = gain * x + offset
        residual = r - predicted
        floor = 32 * eps * max(np.max(np.abs(r)), np.max(np.abs(predicted)))
        keep = np.abs(residual) <= max(spike_sigma * 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(residual)), floor)
        x, r = x[keep], r[keep]
        if x.size < 2 or np.ptp(x) == 0:
            raise ValueError('Calibration screening left no identifiable sweep.')
        xc = x - x.mean()
        gain = (xc @ (r - r.mean())) / (xc @ xc)
        offset = r.mean() - gain * x.mean()
        if not np.isfinite(gain) or gain == 0:
            raise ValueError('Bank gain is not invertible.')
        rows = row_bank == bank
        y[rows] = (y[rows] - offset) / gain
    return y


def separable_transport_responses(lengths: tuple[float, float], diffusivities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], velocities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], robin: tuple[float, float], axis_reactions: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], reaction_map: np.ndarray, source_modes: np.ndarray, shifts: np.ndarray, sensor_cells: np.ndarray, circulation_trace: np.ndarray, circulation_limit: float, *, separability_tol: float = 1e-10) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return shift-major sampled design and per-mode fields at the last shift.

    Uniform cell-centered axes have positive diffusivity, cellwise upwinding,
    zero external inflow values, and one Robin coefficient per axis. Use
    consistent L, L^2/T, L/T and 1/T units; forcing has field/T units. Sensor
    rows are (x-cell, y-cell), in the same order for each shift. No graph or
    waveform is used. There is no regularization of the forward response;
    reaction additivity is checked at relative tolerance 1e-10 by default.
    """
    v = np.asarray(reaction_map, dtype=float)
    vx, vy = v.mean(axis=1), v.mean(axis=0) - v.mean()
    if (np.max(np.abs(v - vx[:, None] - vy[None, :])) > separability_tol * np.max(np.abs(v))
            or np.max(circulation_trace) > circulation_limit):
        raise ValueError('Outside the laminar separable regime.')

    def axis_basis(axis: int, extra: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        k = np.asarray(diffusivities[axis], dtype=float)
        if k.size < 2 or np.any(k <= 0) or lengths[axis] <= 0 or robin[axis] < 0:
            raise ValueError('Each axis needs positive length and diffusivity, at least two cells, and nonnegative Robin transfer.')
        h = lengths[axis] / k.size
        diffusion_rate = (k / h) / h
        d = 2 * diffusion_rate[:-1] * diffusion_rate[1:] / (diffusion_rate[:-1] + diffusion_rate[1:])
        speed = np.asarray(velocities[axis], dtype=float) / h
        main = np.asarray(axis_reactions[axis], dtype=float) + extra + np.abs(speed)
        main[:-1] += d
        main[1:] += d
        edge = np.array([0, k.size - 1])
        robin_rate = robin[axis] / h
        main[edge] += robin_rate / (1 + 0.5 * robin_rate / diffusion_rate[edge])
        lower = d + np.maximum(speed[1:], 0)
        upper = d - np.minimum(speed[:-1], 0)
        log_scale = np.r_[0., np.cumsum(0.5 * (np.log(lower) - np.log(upper)))]
        log_scale -= 0.5 * (log_scale.max() + log_scale.min())
        values, basis = eigh_tridiagonal(main, -np.sqrt(lower) * np.sqrt(upper))
        return values, np.exp(log_scale)[:, None] * basis, basis.T * np.exp(-log_scale)

    dx, px, ix = axis_basis(0, vx)
    dy, py, iy = axis_basis(1, vy)
    shifts = np.asarray(shifts, dtype=float)
    rate = max(np.max(np.abs(dx)), np.max(np.abs(dy)), np.max(np.abs(shifts)))
    if rate == 0:
        raise ValueError('The shifted operator is singular.')
    spectrum = ix @ (np.asarray(source_modes, dtype=float) / rate) @ iy.T
    eigsum = dx[:, None] / rate + dy[None, :] / rate
    i, j = np.asarray(sensor_cells).T
    blocks = []
    for shift in shifts:
        denominator = eigsum + shift / rate
        if np.min(np.abs(denominator)) <= 64 * np.finfo(float).eps:
            raise ValueError('A shifted operator is numerically singular.')
        fields = px @ (spectrum / denominator) @ py.T
        blocks.append(fields[:, i, j].T)
    return np.concatenate(blocks, axis=0), fields


def fit_box_simplex(design: np.ndarray, observations: np.ndarray, nuisance: np.ndarray, upper: float, budget: float, *, source_ridge: float, nuisance_ridge: float = 0.0, tol: float = 1e-12) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict]:
    """Fit nonnegative source weights with a common cap and fixed total.

    Apply the same nuisance residual map to design and observations. The loss
    is the squared norm of that residual, not the minimized joint nuisance
    ridge objective. Nuisance ridge defaults to zero (orthogonal projection);
    nonnegative source ridge is caller-supplied. The active set uses cap-scaled
    coordinates and normalized gradients. The certificate uses physical weight
    units and stationarity gradient - nu_sum - lam_lower + lam_upper = 0.
    """
    a, y, z = (np.asarray(x, dtype=float) for x in (design, observations, nuisance))
    n = a.shape[1]
    if n == 0 or upper < 0 or not 0 <= budget <= n * upper or min(source_ridge, nuisance_ridge) < 0 or tol <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Infeasible box-simplex or invalid regularization/tolerance.')
    if z.shape[1]:
        u, s, _ = np.linalg.svd(z, full_matrices=False)
        if nuisance_ridge == 0:
            shrink = s > np.finfo(float).eps * max(z.shape) * s[0]
        else:
            shrink = s**2 / (s**2 + nuisance_ridge)
        values = np.column_stack((a, y))
        values -= u @ (shrink[:, None] * (u.T @ values))
        a, y = values[:, :-1], values[:, -1]

    if budget == 0 or budget == n * upper:
        w = np.full(n, 0.0 if budget == 0 else upper)
        g = a.T @ (a @ w - y) + source_ridge * w
        nu = g.min() if budget == 0 else g.max()
    else:
        total = budget / upper
        b = a * upper
        h = b.T @ b + (source_ridge * upper**2) * np.eye(n)
        c = b.T @ y
        scale = max(np.max(np.abs(h)), np.max(np.abs(c))) or 1.0
        h, c = h / scale, c / scale
        q = np.full(n, total / n)
        state = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
        for _ in range(20 * n * n):
            gq = h @ q - c
            free = np.flatnonzero(state == 0)
            if not free.size:
                donors, receivers = np.flatnonzero(state == 1), np.flatnonzero(state == -1)
                donor = donors[np.argmax(gq[donors])]
                receiver = receivers[np.argmin(gq[receivers])]
                if gq[donor] <= gq[receiver] + tol:
                    level = 0.5 * (gq[donor] + gq[receiver])
                    break
                state[[donor, receiver]] = 0
                continue
            k = free.size
            system = np.ones((k + 1, k + 1))
            system[:k, :k] = h[np.ix_(free, free)]
            system[-1, -1] = 0
            rhs = np.r_[-gq[free], total - q.sum()]
            try:
                update = np.linalg.solve(system, rhs)
            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                update = np.linalg.lstsq(system, rhs, rcond=None)[0]
            step, level = update[:-1], -update[-1]
            candidate = q[free] + step
            crossing = np.flatnonzero((candidate < -tol) | (candidate > 1 + tol))
            if crossing.size:
                caps = (step[crossing] > 0).astype(float)
                fractions = (caps - q[free[crossing]]) / step[crossing]
                j = np.argmin(fractions)
                q[free] = np.clip(q[free] + fractions[j] * step, 0, 1)
                idx = free[crossing[j]]
                q[idx], state[idx] = caps[j], (1 if caps[j] else -1)
                continue
            q[free] = np.clip(candidate, 0, 1)
            violation = state * (h @ q - c - level)
            idx = np.argmax(violation)
            if violation[idx] <= tol:
                break
            state[idx] = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('Box-simplex active set did not converge.')
        w, nu = upper * q, level * scale / upper
        g = a.T @ (a @ w - y) + source_ridge * w
        reduced = g * (upper / scale) - level
        if (abs(q.sum() - total) > 100 * n * tol
                or reduced @ q - np.minimum(reduced, 0).sum() > 100 * n * tol):
            raise RuntimeError('Box-simplex solution failed the feasibility or dual-gap check.')

    residual = a @ w - y
    objective = 0.5 * (residual @ residual + source_ridge * (w @ w))
    lam_lower, lam_upper = np.maximum(g - nu, 0), np.maximum(nu - g, 0)
    gap = lam_lower @ w + lam_upper @ (upper - w) + nu * (w.sum() - budget)
    return w, {'weights': w.copy(), 'nu_sum': float(nu), 'lam_lower': lam_lower,
               'lam_upper': lam_upper, 'primal_objective': float(objective),
               'dual_lower_bound': float(objective - max(gap, 0.0))}
",
  "synthetic_unit_test_code": "def run_self_test():
    import numpy as np

    rng = np.random.default_rng(14)
    k = (np.array([1., 2., 4.]), np.array([2., 1.]))
    velocity = (np.array([-1., 2., 3.]), np.array([2., -1.]))
    robin = (2., 1.)
    base = (np.array([.1, .2, .3]), np.array([.4, .1]))
    rx, ry = np.array([.2, .1, .4]), np.array([.3, .6])
    reaction = rx[:, None] + ry[None, :]
    modes = rng.normal(size=(4, 3, 2))
    shifts = np.array([.1, .8, 2.])
    cells = np.indices((3, 2)).reshape(2, -1).T
    trace, limit = np.array([.1, .2]), .2
    design, fields = separable_transport_responses((3., 2.), k, velocity, robin, base, reaction, modes, shifts, cells, trace, limit)

    # Independent dense reference at h = 1 on both axes; includes both signs
    # of advection, finite Robin leakage, and missing upstream neighbors.
    d, e = 4 / 3, 8 / 3
    ax = np.array([[1+d+1, -d-1, 0], [-d-2, 2+d+e, -e], [0, -e-3, 3+e+8/5]]) + np.diag(base[0] + rx)
    ay = np.array([[2+d+4/5, -d], [-d, 1+d+2/3]]) + np.diag(base[1] + ry)
    operator = np.kron(ax, np.eye(2)) + np.kron(np.eye(3), ay)
    dense = [np.linalg.solve(operator + shift * np.eye(6), modes.reshape(4, 6).T) for shift in shifts]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(design, np.vstack(dense), atol=2e-13)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(fields, dense[-1].T.reshape(4, 3, 2), atol=2e-13)

    # Convert length units by 0.01 and rates by 2, preserving dimensionless
    # transport and field amplitudes. There is no carrier or reciprocal graph.
    x, rate = .01, 2.
    scaled = separable_transport_responses((3*x, 2*x), tuple(a*x*x*rate for a in k), tuple(a*x*rate for a in velocity), tuple(a*x*rate for a in robin), tuple(a*rate for a in base), reaction*rate, modes*rate, shifts*rate, cells[::-1], trace*x*x*rate, limit*x*x*rate)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled[0].reshape(3, 6, 4)[:, ::-1, :], design.reshape(3, 6, 4), atol=2e-13)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled[1], fields, atol=2e-13)
    interaction = reaction.copy()
    interaction[0, 0] += .01
    for bad_reaction, bad_trace in ((interaction, trace), (reaction, trace * 1.01)):
        try:
            separable_transport_responses((3., 2.), k, velocity, robin, base, bad_reaction, modes, shifts, cells, bad_trace, limit)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert 'laminar separable' in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Expected rejection outside the laminar branch')

    # Construct observations whose known optimum has a lower and an upper
    # active bound, using the residual map computed independently.
    n = design.shape[0]
    z = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), np.linspace(-1, 1, n)))
    nr, sr, cap = .4, .07, .6
    p = np.eye(n) - z @ np.linalg.solve(z.T @ z + nr * np.eye(2), z.T)
    dp = p @ design
    expected = np.array([0., .25, .45, .6])
    wanted_gradient = np.array([.2, 0., 0., -.3])
    residual = np.linalg.lstsq(dp.T, wanted_gradient - sr * expected, rcond=None)[0]
    y = np.linalg.solve(p, dp @ expected - residual)
    banks = np.arange(n) % 2
    sweep_banks = np.repeat([0, 1], 9)
    ref = np.tile(np.linspace(-2, 2, 9), 2)
    gains, offsets = np.array([1.4, .75]), np.array([.3, -.4])
    sweeps = gains[sweep_banks] * ref + offsets[sweep_banks]
    sweeps[[4, 13]] += [50., -80.]
    calibrated = calibrate_affine_banks(gains[banks] * y + offsets[banks], banks, ref, sweeps, sweep_banks)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(calibrated, y, atol=2e-13)
    w, cert = fit_box_simplex(design, calibrated, z, cap, expected.sum(), source_ridge=sr, nuisance_ridge=nr)
    assert np.isfinite(design).all() and np.isfinite(fields).all() and np.isfinite(w).all()
    assert all(np.all(np.isfinite(value)) for value in cert.values())
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w, expected, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(np.einsum('m,mij->ij', w, fields), (dense[-1] @ expected).reshape(3, 2), atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w.sum(), expected.sum(), atol=2e-13)
    grad = dp.T @ (dp @ w - p @ y) + sr * w
    np.testing.assert_allclose(grad - cert['nu_sum'] - cert['lam_lower'] + cert['lam_upper'], 0., atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_lower'] * w + cert['lam_upper'] * (cap - w), 0., atol=2e-11)
    assert 0 <= cert['primal_objective'] - cert['dual_lower_bound'] < 2e-11
    for budget, optimum in ((0., [0., 0.]), (1., [1., 0.]), (2., [1., 1.])):
        vertex, vc = fit_box_simplex(np.eye(2), np.array([2., -1.]), np.empty((2, 0)), 1., budget, source_ridge=.1)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(vertex, optimum, atol=2e-13)
        assert 0 <= vc['primal_objective'] - vc['dual_lower_bound'] < 2e-13


run_self_test()
"
}
